questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the direct scan or simulation approach for Transpose Matrix?

choices.label: Swap every pair twice in a full two-dimensional loop.
choices.feedback: Double swapping restores the original values and also fails for rectangular shapes.

choices.label: Create a new matrix with swapped dimensions. Read original row-column coordinates in reversed order for each output cell.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Create a new matrix with swapped dimensions. Read original row-column coordinates in reversed order for each output cell.

choices.label: Allocate the output with the same dimensions for every matrix.
choices.feedback: A non-square transpose swaps its row and column counts.

choices.label: Reverse each row without swapping coordinates.
choices.feedback: That is a horizontal reflection, not a transpose.
